nodes.description: Public string state variable `name` of HogeShiba, set to "HogeShiba" in the constructor.
Public string state variable `symbol` of HogeShiba, set to "SHIBH" in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable `decimals`, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 `_totalSupply` holding the total token supply (1e30), assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) `balances` tracking token balances; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) `allowed` holding ERC20 allowances; written in approve and transferFrom, read by allowance.
constructor(): mints the entire supply to msg.sender and initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and balances, then emits Transfer.
totalSupply(): returns `_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]` using raw unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): view returning balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-address or return-value checks.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): decrements balances[msg.sender] and increments balances[to] through safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): decrements balances[from] and the caller allowance, increments balances[to], emits Transfer.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a (overflow guard).
safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b (underflow guard).
safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b (overflow guard).
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as the mint recipient in the constructor and as the authorization subject/index key in approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction `_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]` inside totalSupply().
Balance mutation `balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens)` inside transfer().
Balance mutation `balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens)` inside transfer().
Balance mutation `balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens)` inside transferFrom().
Allowance mutation `allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens)` inside transferFrom().
Balance mutation `balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens)` inside transferFrom().
Unsigned addition `c = a + b` in safeAdd(), guarded by `require(c >= a)`.
Unsigned subtraction `c = a - b` in safeSub(), guarded by `require(b <= a)`.
Unsigned multiplication `c = a * b` in safeMul(), guarded by `require(a == 0 || c / a == b)`.
Unsigned division `c = a / b` in safeDiv(), guarded by `require(b > 0)`.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial minted supply in the constructor.
approve writes the allowance keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer debits the balance indexed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transferFrom debits the allowance of the caller-controlled msg.sender without any additional authorization check.
tokenOwner is the lookup key for balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes allowed[msg.sender] when storing the approved amount.
tokens is the value written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
to is the destination whose balance is credited in transfer.
tokens is the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd in transfer.
from is the balance owner debited in transferFrom without explicit approval verification beyond the allowance mutation.
to is the destination credited in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount used for the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
a is the first operand of the addition in safeAdd.
b is the second operand of the addition in safeAdd.
local c receives the result of a + b in safeAdd.
a is the minuend of the subtraction in safeSub.
b is the subtrahend guarded by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
local c receives the result of a - b in safeSub.
a is the first operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
b is the second operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
local c receives the result of a * b in safeMul.
a is the numerator of the division in safeDiv.
b is the denominator guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.
local c receives the result of a / b in safeDiv.
constructor writes the token name.
constructor writes the token symbol.
constructor writes the decimals value.
constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial minted amount.
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the full supply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in the raw subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping to decrement the caller allowance.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub to debit balances[from].
transferFrom invokes safeSub on the caller allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit balances[to].
safeAdd executes the unsigned addition c = a + b.
safeSub executes the unsigned subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul executes the unsigned multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv executes the unsigned division c = a / b.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice (balance and allowance debit).
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
